title: AI Agent & Automation Engineer
description:
Hiring: AI Agent & Automation Engineer

**Agentic AI | AI Automation | Multi-Agent Systems | n8n | MCP | AI Development**

**Company:** Frontier Group  
**Location:** Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Industry:** Automobile Dealerships | Diversified Business Group | Technology & Automation  
**Salary:** Based on experience and demonstrated technical capabilities

***About Frontier Group***

Frontier Group is a diversified business group headquartered in Gurugram, with automobile dealerships forming a major part of its business operations, alongside other ventures and services.

As we continue to expand and modernize our businesses, we are looking to integrate Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, and advanced digital technologies into our day-to-day operations.

We are building an AI-driven ecosystem where intelligent agents, automation workflows, and integrated software systems can improve efficiency, reduce manual work, enhance decision-making, and support business growth across our group companies.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptionally capable, hands-on **AI Agent & Automation Engineer** to lead the development and implementation of practical AI-powered solutions across Frontier Group.

**We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use ChatGPT. We are looking for someone who knows how to build with AI.**

The successful candidate will work across multiple group companies, departments, and business functions to identify challenges, develop intelligent solutions, and implement automation systems that deliver measurable business results.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving real business problems using emerging technologies and is comfortable taking projects from concept to working deployment.

Key Responsibilities

**AI Agents & Intelligent Systems**

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI agents capable of executing complex, multi-step business tasks.
* Build multi-agent workflows and AI systems that interact with databases, external services, and enterprise applications.
* Develop AI-powered assistants and tools for operational and management teams.
* Implement agent memory, knowledge retrieval, function calling, and human approval workflows.

**Business Process Automation**

* Study existing workflows across Frontier Group companies and identify opportunities for AI-powered automation.
* Build automation using n8n, APIs, webhooks, and custom programming.
* Automate repetitive administrative, sales, customer service, reporting, and operational activities.
* Design solutions that reduce manual intervention while improving accuracy and productivity.

**Software Development & AI Integration**

* Develop and maintain AI-enabled web applications, dashboards, and internal business tools.
* Integrate AI models with existing applications, CRMs, ERPs, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs, and modern AI development frameworks.
* Use AI coding tools to accelerate application development, testing, debugging, and deployment.

**Cross-Company Digital Transformation**

* Collaborate with different companies and departments within Frontier Group.
* Understand operational challenges in automobile dealerships and other group businesses.
* Develop AI solutions for lead management, customer engagement, service operations, inventory processes, document processing, management reporting, and other business activities.
* Build reusable AI tools that can be adapted across multiple group companies.

**System Reliability & Improvement**

* Test, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize deployed AI systems.
* Implement appropriate security, permissions, logging, error handling, and human oversight.
* Continuously explore new AI capabilities and recommend technologies that provide practical business value.

Required Technical Skills

**1. AI Agents & LLM Technologies**

* OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or comparable AI models and APIs.
* Agentic AI, tool calling, autonomous workflows, and multi-agent architectures.
* LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
* Prompt engineering, structured outputs, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.

**2. Automation & Integration**

* Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms.
* MCP servers, AI tool integrations, REST APIs, and webhooks.
* Connecting AI systems to databases, business applications, and external platforms.

**3. Programming & Software Engineering**

* Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, or similar database technologies.
* Git, GitHub, version control, and software development workflows.
* Familiarity with frontend/backend technologies, cloud hosting, and application deployment.

**4. AI-Powered Development Tools**

* Practical experience with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to develop, debug, test, and improve applications using AI-assisted development workflows.

**5. Problem-Solving & Business Understanding**

* Strong analytical thinking and technical troubleshooting abilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into working technical solutions.
* Understanding of reliability, data security, access control, and responsible use of AI.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have personally built functional AI agents, automations, or AI-integrated applications.
* Can demonstrate real projects rather than only theoretical knowledge.
* Can independently research, design, develop, and deploy solutions.
* Are comfortable learning new technologies and working across different business domains.
* Understand that successful AI implementation requires practical engineering, business understanding, and continuous improvement.
* Are innovative, self-driven, and passionate about the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.

Qualifications & Experience

* Preferably 2+ years of experience in software development, AI automation, or related technical fields.
* Proven practical experience with AI agents, LLM integrations, or business automation.
* Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
* Candidates with exceptional practical expertise, strong portfolios, or independently developed projects are strongly encouraged to apply.

Why Join Frontier Group?

* Work on AI initiatives that impact multiple companies within a diversified business group.
* Gain exposure to real-world operations in the automobile industry and other sectors.
* Take ownership of AI projects from initial idea through implementation.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and convert them into meaningful business solutions.
* Work directly on practical automation challenges with measurable outcomes.
* Play an important role in shaping the group's AI and digital transformation journey.

How to Apply

**Your practical skills matter more to us than your certificates.**

Along with your application, please share:

* Details of AI agents, automation workflows, or AI-powered applications you have personally developed.
* Your hands-on experience with n8n, MCP, LLM APIs, and relevant development frameworks.
* Links to GitHub projects, portfolios, demos, or examples of working solutions, where available.
* An example of a real business problem you solved using AI or automation.

Candidates who can demonstrate their technical capabilities through practical examples or live project demonstrations will receive preference.

**If you can turn Artificial Intelligence into real business solutions, Frontier Group wants to hear from you.**

Join us in building intelligent, automated, and technology-driven businesses.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
Job Description – QA Engineer / Quality Assurance Engineer

**Location:** Gurugram  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly responsible and technically capable **QA Engineer** who takes complete ownership of the quality of work assigned to them. The candidate must be committed to completing tasks **correctly, thoroughly, and within agreed timelines**.

This role requires someone who does not simply identify bugs, but actively works with developers and stakeholders to ensure issues are resolved and the final product is stable and ready for delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Take complete ownership of assigned QA tasks from start to final closure.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, API and system testing.
* Identify, document, track and verify bugs until complete resolution.
* Ensure releases are thoroughly tested before delivery to clients or stakeholders.
* Prepare and execute detailed test cases, test scenarios and QA checklists.
* Test APIs, backend services and application workflows.
* Work closely with developers to reproduce and resolve technical issues.
* Verify fixes and ensure that resolved bugs do not create new problems.
* Maintain clear documentation of testing activities, defects and results.
* Proactively identify potential quality or performance issues instead of waiting for them to appear in production.
* Take responsibility for completing work accurately and within committed deadlines.
* Communicate immediately if there is any risk of delay rather than waiting until the deadline.
* Be willing to extend working hours occasionally when an important release, client delivery or critical issue requires completion.
* Maintain a strong sense of accountability for the quality of the final product.

Technical Skills Required

The candidate **must have working knowledge of:**

* **Python**
* **Docker**
* **Cloud platforms** such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* API Testing
* REST APIs
* Postman or similar API testing tools
* Manual Testing
* Regression Testing
* Integration Testing
* Bug Tracking and Defect Management
* Git / Version Control
* Basic understanding of databases and SQL

Knowledge of **Selenium, Playwright, PyTest or other automation testing frameworks** will be a strong advantage.

Candidate We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who:

* Takes **ownership rather than waiting for continuous supervision**.
* Completes tasks correctly and on time.
* Has strong attention to detail.
* Is responsible and dependable.
* Is comfortable working in a fast-paced technology environment.
* Can coordinate effectively with developers, managers, clients and other stakeholders.
* Has good written and spoken English communication skills.
* Is willing to learn new technologies and testing tools.
* Understands that quality assurance means being accountable for the final quality of the work.
* Is comfortable working **6 days a week from our Gurugram office**.
* Can stay beyond normal working hours occasionally when a critical deadline or release genuinely requires it.

Important

This is a **work-from-office and ownership-driven role**. Candidates looking primarily for remote/hybrid work or who are uncomfortable taking responsibility for deadlines and quality may not be suitable for this position.

We welcome candidates who believe in **responsibility, precision, timely delivery and continuous improvement** and want to grow with a fast-moving AI and technology organisation.

Pay: ₹342,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

title: BIM Automation Engineer
description:
Nurture Xcel, Gurugram, some client travel. 3 to 5 years.

Construction firms keep their projects in Autodesk: Revit models, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Forma. Much of the checking and reporting around them is still done by hand. We're automating it.

You'll build jobs on Autodesk's cloud APIs: checks of models against a company's design and BIM standards, quantities from a model into a client's BOQ, what changed between 2 model revisions, reports from project data, and early site checks in Forma such as FAR and ground coverage. Where a job needs it, you'll write a Revit add-in. You'll test your work on client models.

You must have hands-on work with the Revit API in C#, and you know how BIM teams work. Autodesk Platform Services, Dynamo, Autodesk Construction Cloud APIs or Forma extensions are a plus.

How we work: AI agents write most of the code and tests and read through Autodesk's docs. You lead them and decide what's right.

Hiring test: a short test on a sample Revit model. Run 1 check against a written standard and tell us what you'd check next.

Join by Tue 1 Dec 2026 if you can, and tell us your notice period. Email your CV to hr@nurturexcel.com with the role in the subject line.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Job Overview
  
  
**About the Role:**  
**The team:** Our Engineering team develops and maintains modern, cloud-based applications and AI-powered solutions that support global business operations. Team members collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, and DevOps functions to build reliable, secure, and scalable solutions. The team embraces agile delivery practices and encourages continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities and impact:**  
We are seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering team. The SDET will be responsible for ensuring that all product releases meet the highest quality standards and align with business requirements. You will work closely with software engineers, product owners, architects, and subject matter experts to understand product functionality, design effective test strategies, and build robust automation frameworks. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on complex, high-volume distributed systems while contributing to automation, quality engineering, and continuous delivery practices.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* System & Domain Expertise: Gain deep knowledge of product requirements, architecture, code flows, and Asset Management/Post-Trade processing to inform development and quality processes.
* Automation Strategy & Frameworks: Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive automated test frameworks for functional, API, integration, regression, and performance testing, leveraging Python scripting to drive release efficiency.
* Test Execution & Validation: Build and execute automated test cases for high-volume, distributed, service-oriented systems while conducting thorough API (including performance validation using JMeter), database, and end-to-end testing.
* Collaboration & Design Input: Participate in design discussions, contribute to Agile ceremonies (sprints, planning, retrospectives), and provide recommendations on testability and quality improvements across the lifecycle.
* Infrastructure & Cross-Functional Teamwork: Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and release teams to ensure continuous product quality.
* Process, Research & Leadership: Research modern testing methodologies, maintain accurate documentation and status reporting, and assist with technical interviews and hiring.

**What we’re looking for:**  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  

* Education, Core QA & Agile Skills: Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, or IT with 2-5 years of SDET/QA experience, emphasizing expertise in software testing methodologies, API performance testing using JMeter, QA best practices, database testing, SQL, and data validation, supported by excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Automation Tech Stack: Demonstrates hands-on proficiency in building scalable automation solutions using Java or Python, Playwright, JavaScript, and BDD frameworks, coupled with the ability to effectively troubleshoot complex distributed applications.
* GenAI & AI Ecosystem Proficiency: Possesses specialized experience testing Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Chatbots, Copilots, Prompt Engineering, and RAG solutions (including AI response validation/evaluation), with deep familiarity in the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph), Vector Databases, Semantic Search, and major AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Claude, and Google Gemini).

Preferred skills
  

* Infrastructure, Cloud & CI/CD: Proficiency with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, combined with exposure to CI/CD tooling including Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
* System Architecture & Testing: A solid understanding of service-oriented and event-driven architecture patterns, supported by proven experience in testing high-volume, distributed systems.
* Domain & Emerging Technology: Knowledge of Web 3.0 concepts, Distributed Ledger Technologies, or Blockchain ecosystems, alongside operational exposure to Asset Management, Post-Trade Processing, Financial Markets, or Reference Data platforms.

**The location:** Gurgaon,India
  
  
**Our Benefits:** Global vision, local impact
  
At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
  
  
**Our approach is built on three core pillars:**  

* Global foundations: We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health & Wellness, Financial Security, and Work-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well-being.
* Locally tailored: We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
* Flexibility and growth: We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.

The Trust employee ownership plan
  
Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly. This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
  
About OSTTRA
  
We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
  
Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end-to-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
  
Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
  
Joining our team now is a unique opportunity - you will help to shape the next generation of post-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more atwww.osttra.com.
  
Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA
  
We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on.
